name: Hajj and Umrah operators

problems.words: Saudi hotel and transport costs change after we've sold the package
quick_ideas: Compare one recent group's costs at sale time and at departure, so you see which line moved most
Note when each cost was confirmed, so you know where the exposure sits.

workzap_build.text: a package costing sheet per group with SAR costs and exchange-rate inputs, showing live margin every time a cost or rate changes.

problems.ask_first: Hotels ka rate aap package bechne se pehle confirm karte hain ya baad mein?
problems.free_stops: How costs and exchange rates feed the live margin is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare what you quoted against what you finally paid for one recent departure, so you spot whether hotels or transport hurt margin more.
Make one staff member note supplier confirmations in one notebook each afternoon, so sales stop relying on unconfirmed costs.

problems.words: Families pay in instalments and some stop near departure
quick_ideas: List every booking's instalment status once by reference number, so you see who's behind
Agree a clear cut-off before departure, so staff aren't deciding case by case.

workzap_build.text: an instalment tracker per booking reference (no ID data) with scheduled reminders and departure cut-off flags.

problems.ask_first: Zyada tar families upfront dete hain ya instalments mein?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and cut-off rules are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many bookings were still short near the last departure, so you see how often instalments stall at the riskiest time.
Give one person a daily instalment follow-up hour and one notebook for all due bookings, so departures stop getting blocked by scattered chasing.

problems.words: Saudi partners want money before we've collected
quick_ideas: Put partner due dates next to expected collections for the coming season once, so the gap weeks are visible
Talk to your accountant about the gap early, so it isn't a surprise.

workzap_build.text: a partner payment schedule showing what's due to Saudi partners against collections per group, updated daily.

problems.ask_first: Saudi partners ko payment kab tak deni hoti hai?
problems.free_stops: How collections and payments are matched per group is worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note one recent season's partner payment dates beside your own collection dates, so you see exactly when cash pressure bites hardest.
Give one person the job of updating one weekly dues list, so partner payments and incoming collections are watched together.

problems.words: Room allocation in Excel and families end up split
quick_ideas: Check your last rooming list against what happened on arrival, so you see where splits came from
Have one person own the final rooming list, so late changes don't get lost.

workzap_build.text: a rooming list builder that keeps family groups together by booking reference and exports clean lists for each hotel.

problems.ask_first: Rooming list abhi kaun banata hai?
problems.free_stops: The grouping rules and hotel export format are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many families were split across rooms on one recent trip, so you see whether allocation mistakes are occasional or routine.
Give one person the final say on room changes in one place, so families stop being split by mixed messages.

problems.words: Pilgrims' WhatsApp group becomes chaos, nobody reads updates
quick_ideas: Separate announcements from chat for your next group, so important updates aren't buried
Decide who is allowed to post announcements, so there's one voice.

workzap_build.text: a broadcast and pinned-update flow for each group during the trip, with read confirmations so you see who missed an update.

problems.ask_first: Ek group mein taqreeban kitne log hote hain?
problems.free_stops: The broadcast setup and read tracking are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Look at one recent group chat and count how many update messages were buried by replies, so you see why pilgrims miss key notices.
Set one fixed time for official group updates from one staff member, so important notices land without constant chat clutter.

problems.words: Group leaders on the ground can't reach the office quickly
quick_ideas: Agree the few things group leaders report each day, so reports are useful
Name one office contact per group, so leaders know who to call.

workzap_build.text: a daily phone report from each group leader on transport, hotel, issues and expenses with photo receipts, landing in one office view.

problems.ask_first: Group leaders abhi office ko kaise report karte hain?
problems.free_stops: The report fields and office view are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how long the office waited for answers from the ground on one recent day, so you see where communication slows decisions.
Give each group one office handover contact for every shift, so leaders reach the right desk without repeated calling around.

problems.words: Pending documents per group get lost track of
quick_ideas: Make one received-or-pending list per group by booking reference, so the gaps are visible
Give each group's documents one owner, so chasing isn't shared vaguely.

workzap_build.text: a document checklist per booking (received or pending by type, without storing contents) with deadline alerts per group.

problems.ask_first: Ek season mein kitne groups chalte hain, taqreeban?
problems.free_stops: The checklist types and alert timing are worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk through one active group's file and count how many items are still marked pending, so missing paperwork gets sized clearly.
Keep one pending-items list in one place under one staff owner, so each group's chases move in an orderly routine.

problems.words: Hundreds of enquiries before Ramadan and we can't follow up
quick_ideas: Go through open enquiries once and reply to all, so you see how many were waiting
Note the questions asked most often, so you know what people need answered first.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry tracker for peak season with auto-replies to common package questions and follow-up reminders, with conversion seen per week.

problems.ask_first: Enquiries zyada WhatsApp pe aati hain ya calls pe?
problems.free_stops: The auto-reply content and follow-up timing are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many open enquiries are older than your usual reply pace, so you see the real backlog before Ramadan rush grows.
Give one staff member one follow-up block and one enquiry list each day, so unanswered leads stop drifting between people.

problems.words: Families from last year don't come back
quick_ideas: Ask last season's families how their trip was, so you hear what kept them away
Keep a list of families who agreed to hear from you, so you can reach them next season.

workzap_build.text: a post-trip feedback form and an opted-in re-contact flow before each season, with returning families tracked.

problems.ask_first: Trip ke baad families se feedback lete hain?
problems.free_stops: The feedback questions and re-contact timing are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare how many last season's families asked again versus stayed silent, so you judge whether repeat demand is slipping or stable.
Give one person a single notebook for past-family follow-ups at a fixed weekly time, so return business gets regular attention.

problems.words: Sub-agents collect money and are slow to pass it on
quick_ideas: List what each sub-agent has collected and passed on once, so you see the gap
Agree a fixed remittance day, so it's expected, not chased.

workzap_build.text: a sub-agent collections ledger with balances, remittance dates and scheduled reminders.

problems.ask_first: Kitne sub-agents aap ke packages bechte hain?
problems.free_stops: The remittance rules and reminders are worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many days each recent sub-agent held collections before passing them on, so the worst delays stop surprising your cash planning.
Give one staff member a single remittance notebook checked each afternoon, so every sub-agent delay is chased from one place.

never_say: Religious rulings or fiqh answers; gently say that's for a scholar.
Visa, immigration, quota or Nusuk policy advice, or any view on Saudi or home-country ministry rules.
Health, vaccination or fitness-to-travel advice for pilgrims.
Anything that helps with quota resale, fake visas or bookings, unlicensed Hajj or misleading package claims (such as overstating hotel distance from the Haram).
Any storage of pilgrims' names, passport, CNIC or Emirates ID numbers, photos, mahram or medical details.

sample_reply.person: Is saal Makkah ke hotel rates package bechne ke baad barh gaye, poora margin chala gaya. Aage ke liye kya karein?
sample_reply.pi:
Ji haan, shuruaat chhoti si ho sakti hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, pichle group ki costs sale ke waqt aur departure ke waqt ek dafa aamne saamne rakh lein, taa ke pata chale kaun si line sab se zyada hili.
Doosra, har cost kab confirm hui thi woh note kar lein, taa ke samajh aaye khatra kahan baitha hai.
Is ko mazboot karne ke liye Workzap ye de sakta hai: har group ki SAR costs aur exchange rate ek sheet mein, aur jaise hi koi rate badle, us group ka margin foran nazar aa jaye.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
